name: combobox
need: Choose a value from a long list by typing to filter it: groups, descriptions, several values

--ds-combo-option-height.description: combobox option: the base height (size md, comfortable density) that size and density steps apply to; a least height, its text may need more

--ds-combo-radius.description: the corners of the combobox list, times `--ds-shape`

labExempt.DS.combobox.create: the controller; the list's motion is DS.overlay's (the combobox entries of styleguide/lab.js) and the chips' are the chip's

ripple..ds-combo__option: pointer-down selects and closes the list; the state layer is the feedback

focus..ds-combo--multi: forced colours: the box draws the field, so it takes the ring a field shows on any focus

rotate..ds-combo__toggle svg: disclosure chevrons: the combobox chevron turns 180deg with its list (D25)
